label: Natural gas
sourceNote: U.S. average residential price, dollars per thousand cubic feet, nominal. EIA table release date 2026-09-30. July is outside the main heating season, so this average is not a winter bill.

label: Propane
sourceNote: U.S. residential propane price, dollars per gallon, weekly heating oil and propane survey. Page release date 2026-10-28.

label: Heating oil
sourceNote: U.S. residential heating oil price, dollars per gallon, weekly heating oil and propane survey. Page release date 2026-10-28.

label: Electricity
sourceNote: U.S. residential average revenue per kilowatthour, 18.16 cents, which EIA publishes as a proxy for retail price. Electricity Monthly Update with data for August 2026, release date 2026-10-23.

label: Wood pellets, domestic sales
sourceNote: U.S. total domestic sales average price, dollars per ton, month 7. EIA notes the figure includes all product types and both retail and wholesale sales, so it is not prefilled as a household price. The report page https://www.eia.gov/biofuels/biomass/ titles this release July 2026.
